author: Gabu
description: Generate invite links via a button and track who joins using them.
end_user_data_statement: Stores Discord user IDs of invite creators and members who joined via tracked invites.
install_msg:
Use `[p]invites setup #channel` to place the invite button.

**Required Permissions:**
- `Create Invite` in the target channel
- `Manage Guild` to run setup commands

**Required Intents:**
- `members` intent (for tracking joins)

**Commands:**
- `[p]invites setup [#channel]` — place the invite button
- `[p]invites list` — show all tracked invites
- `[p]invites user [member]` — show a member's invite stats
- `[p]invites channel` — show the configured channel
- `[p]invites clear` — clear all invite data
- `[p]invites remove` — remove the button message
name: InviteTracking
short: Invite link generation and usage tracking.
